messages:
alex: Heads-up: CI on main is red — a bunch of integration tests are failing with Postgres connection errors in the last pipeline run. job: https://ci.redwood/reports/1773500123 :frowning:
infra-bot: [CI] job 1773500123 failed: 12 failing tests. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/1773500123
maria: I pulled the logs — the pg-mock container is restarting repeatedly. see snippet:
```
2026-03-17 09:12:23 ERROR: could not connect to postgres: connection refused
2026-03-17 09:12:23 INFO: pg-mock exiting with code 1
2026-03-17 09:12:24 INFO: restarting pg-mock (uptime 1s)
```
ravi: fyi `kubectl -n ci get pods -l app=pg-mock` shows `CrashLoopBackOff` on the mock pod. stacktrace points at connection-accept loop.
sam: Which tests specifically? I can run the failing ones locally.
alex: Most failures are in `session_store_integration_test` and some in `migrations_integ_test`.
lee: suspicious: yesterday's change to the connection pool settings (commit `b4d7c9a`) touched how pgmock is started in CI. Could be a timing/regression.
maria: On the CI nodes the pg-mock image pulled was `redwood/pg-mock:canary-2026-03-16` — maybe a bad build. Can someone try forcing the stable image? `redwood/pg-mock:stable`.
ravi: I'll try a quick restart and forcing the stable image for the job. Command I ran locally:
```
kubectl -n ci set image deployment/pg-mock pg-mock=redwood/pg-mock:stable
kubectl -n ci rollout restart deployment/pg-mock
kubectl -n ci logs -f deployment/pg-mock
```
sam: If that fixes it, we should rerun the pipeline. Can someone trigger a rerun? @eng-oncall
alex: @eng-infra can you trigger a rerun after the image swap? If not, mark the job to skip flaky tests until fixed.
infra-bot: Rerun requested by alex. Triggering pipeline 1773500123-rerun...
infra-bot: Pipeline 1773500123-rerun started. Linking: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/1773500123-rerun
maria: After forcing `stable` the mock started and stayed up for ~2m, logs show `listening on 5432` then a few connections. But after ~90s it fatal'ed with `out of memory` in the mock process. Could be a memory regression in canary.
lee: Ok, plan: (1) ravi will bisect between `b4d7c9a` and `HEAD` to see if the pool change is root cause, (2) sam will run the failing tests locally against stable image to confirm, (3) maria will open an incident/bug with logs and mark the canary image as suspect.
ravi: I can take the bisect. I'll run `git bisect` with the integration test harness. Rough command:
```
git bisect start HEAD b4d7c9a
# run failing tests in CI harness or local reproducer script
./dev/ci/run_integ.sh session_store_integration_test
```
I expect results within ~45 minutes.
sam: If bisect points to the pool change, we should revert or add a guard flag in CI. Also add a retry/healthcheck for pg-mock startup in the pipeline so transient restarts don't kill the job.
alex: Agreed. Also add an interim mitigation: mark `session_store_integration_test` as flaky (short-term) in the runner config so the main branch can stay green.
maria: Filed issue #INC-623 with logs, image tag, and the failing tests. I'll paste the link once created.
infra-bot: Issue created: https://issues.redwood/INC-623 (pg-mock canary causing CI integration failures)
lee: Quick note — if anyone needs to reproduce exactly what's in CI, use the `ci-repro` script which spins up the same k8s job locally:
```
./scripts/ci-repro --job pg-integ --image redwood/pg-mock:canary-2026-03-16
```
ravi: Starting bisect now. I'll update this thread with the first good/bad commit range.
sam: I'll run the failing test against `redwood/pg-mock:stable` and report back in ~20m.
alex: Thanks all. @ravi please ping if you need the failing logs or local creds. :eyes:
maria: Small follow-up: I'll add a short healthcheck step in the pipeline that waits for pg-mock to respond on `tcp:5432` before starting tests (timeout 60s). Should cut down on flakes.
ravi: Bisect update: narrowed down to commits between `c3f2d1b` and `d1a9b6f`. Running narrowed tests now.
sam: Local run against stable image passed the two failing tests. So likely a regression in canary image. :+1:
alex: OK — looks like canary build is the culprit. Maria — thanks for the pipeline healthcheck. Ravi — please add the bisect result to INC-623 when done.
maria: I'll revert the CI image to `stable` for pipeline runs until the canary is fixed.
infra-bot: [CI] pipeline 1773500123-rerun completed: 0 failing tests (after image swap). Marking original pipeline as impacted by external image regression.
alex: Great work. We'll keep the canary blocked from CI until image team publishes a fixed build. Closing thread for now — reopen if failing pops again. :thumbsup:
